Source code lists

Source: R/code-lists.R
soil_code_lists.Rd

The code lists kept as in the source (GET /code-lists), today the SOTWIS_codes table of three SOTWIS packages (Senegal and The Gambia, Tunisia, Upper Tana), which explains the codes of CLAF, DRAI, ISOC, LITH, LNDF, PHAS, ...

Usage

soil_code_lists(soil = soil_session())

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A data frame, one row per code list and provider: code_list, provider_code, row_count, distinct_entries, attributes (list of character), source_datasets (list of data frames source_record_id, source_dataset_name).

Details

Rights: soil:summary. Capability: code_lists.

See also

soil_code_list()

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_citations(), soil_code_list(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_code_lists(soil)
} # }
